parameters.name: ActionName
parameters.description: The name of the playbook action.

parameters.name: Aliuid
parameters.description: The ID of the user who receives the message.

parameters.name: AssetId
parameters.description: The ID of the asset. This parameter is deprecated.

parameters.name: ChannelTypeList
parameters.description: A collection of channel types. If you do not specify this parameter, messages are sent through all channels by default.

parameters.name: ComponentName
parameters.description: The name of the playbook component.

parameters.name: EventId
parameters.description:
The ID of the message event in Message Center. Valid values:

- yundun\_soar\_incident\_generate: An event is generated.

- yundun\_soar\_alert\_generate: An alert is generated.

- yundun\_soar\_incident\_update: An event is updated.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: NodeName
parameters.description: The name of the playbook node.

parameters.name: Params
parameters.description:
The template parameters for the message event.

- Event generation: aliyunUID, incidentName, incidentID, startTime

- Alert generation: aliyunUID, alertName, alertID, startTime

- Event update: aliyunUID, incidentName, incidentID, startTime, endTime, status, level

parameters.name: PlaybookUuid
parameters.description:
The UUID of the playbook.

> Call the [DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID of the member. This parameter is used when an administrator calls the operation on behalf of a member.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type. Valid values:

- 0 (default): The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all accounts that belong to the enterprise.
